def occurrenceRank [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin xs.length)

theorem occurrenceRank_lt_iff [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) (i j : Fin xs.length) :
    occurrenceRank key xs i < occurrenceRank key xs j ↔
      key xs[i.val]'i.isLt < key xs[j.val]'j.isLt

private theorem strict_filter_length_eq_rank [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ)
    (xs : List α) (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    (xs.filter (fun x => decide (key x < key xs[i.val]'i.isLt))).length =
      (occurrenceRank key xs i).val

theorem left_length_eq_rank [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    ((xs.eraseIdx i.val).filter
      (fun x => decide (key x < key xs[i.val]'i.isLt))).length =
        (occurrenceRank key xs i).val

theorem right_length_eq_rank [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    ((xs.eraseIdx i.val).filter
      (fun x => !(decide (key x < key xs[i.val]'i.isLt)))).length =
        xs.length - 1 - (occurrenceRank key xs i).val

theorem child_keys_nodup [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    (((xs.eraseIdx i.val).filter
      (fun x => decide (key x < key xs[i.val]'i.isLt))).map key).Nodup ∧
    (((xs.eraseIdx i.val).filter
      (fun x => !(decide (key x < key xs[i.val]'i.isLt)))).map key).Nodup

private theorem filtered_remainder_length_lt (xs : List α) (i : Fin xs.length)
    (p : α → Bool) : ((xs.eraseIdx i.val).filter p).length < xs.length

private theorem uniformIndex_map_perm (m : Nat) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) :
    PMF.map σ (uniformIndex m) = uniformIndex m

theorem left_length_law [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (head : α) (tail : List α)
    (hd : ((head :: tail).map key).Nodup) :
    PMF.map (fun i : Fin (tail.length + 1) =>
      (((head :: tail).eraseIdx i.val).filter
        (fun x => decide (key x < key (head :: tail)[i.val]'i.isLt))).length)
      (uniformIndex tail.length) =
        PMF.map (fun i : Fin (tail.length + 1) => i.val) (uniformIndex tail.length)

theorem exerciseMean_eq_of_length_eq [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder ν]
    (key₁ : α → κ) (key₂ : β → ν) (xs : List α) (ys : List β)
    (hx : (xs.map key₁).Nodup) (hy : (ys.map key₂).Nodup)
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key₁ a < key₁ b)) xs =
      exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key₂ a < key₂ b)) ys
def sizeMean (n : Nat) : ℝ

theorem exerciseMean_eq_sizeMean [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs = sizeMean xs.length
@[simp] theorem sizeMean_zero : sizeMean 0 = 1

private theorem sum_rank_children (m : Nat) (A : Nat → ℝ)
    (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) :
    (∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (A (ρ i).val + A (m - (ρ i).val))) =
      2 * ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), A i.val

private theorem exerciseMean_cons_size_formula [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ)
    (head : α) (tail : List α) (hd : ((head :: tail).map key).Nodup) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) (head :: tail) =
      (2 / ((tail.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ)) *
        (∑ i : Fin (tail.length + 1), sizeMean i.val) +
        ((4 * tail.length + 3 : Nat) : ℝ)

theorem sizeMean_succ (m : Nat) :
    sizeMean (m + 1) =
      (2 / ((m + 1 : Nat) : ℝ)) * (∑ i : Fin (m + 1), sizeMean i.val) +
        ((4 * m + 3 : Nat) : ℝ)

theorem sizeMean_recurrence (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    sizeMean n = (2 / (n : ℝ)) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, sizeMean k) +
      4 * (n : ℝ) - 1

theorem empty_rank {α : Type u} {κ : Type v} [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) :
    occurrenceRank key [] = Equiv.refl (Fin 0)

theorem empty_uninhabited_mean :
    exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] = sizeMean 0

theorem singleton_rank {α : Type u} {κ : Type v} [LinearOrder κ]
    (key : α → κ) (x : α) : occurrenceRank key [x] 0 = 0
theorem sizeMean_one : sizeMean 1 = 5
theorem sizeMean_two : sizeMean 2 = 13
theorem sizeMean_three : sizeMean 3 = (71 : ℝ) / 3

theorem three_occurrence_ranks (i : Fin 3) :
    (occurrenceRank (id : Nat → Nat) [2, 0, 1] i).val =
      ([2, 0, 1] : List Nat)[i.val]

theorem three_middle_children :
    (([2, 0, 1] : List Nat).eraseIdx 2).filter
        (fun x => decide (x < ([2, 0, 1] : List Nat)[2])) = [0] ∧
      (([2, 0, 1] : List Nat).eraseIdx 2).filter
        (fun x => !(decide (x < ([2, 0, 1] : List Nat)[2]))) = [2]

theorem three_left_size_law :
    PMF.map (fun i : Fin 3 =>
      ((([2, 0, 1] : List Nat).eraseIdx i.val).filter
        (fun x => decide (x < ([2, 0, 1] : List Nat)[i.val]))).length)
      (uniformIndex 2) = PMF.map (fun i : Fin 3 => i.val) (uniformIndex 2)
theorem three_reordered_exercise_mean : exerciseMean natLt [2, 0, 1] = (71 : ℝ) / 3
theorem sizeMean_four : sizeMean 4 = (109 : ℝ) / 3

theorem four_occurrence_ranks (i : Fin 4) :
    (occurrenceRank (id : Nat → Nat) [3, 1, 0, 2] i).val =
      ([3, 1, 0, 2] : List Nat)[i.val]

theorem four_selected_children :
    (([3, 1, 0, 2] : List Nat).eraseIdx 3).filter
        (fun x => decide (x < ([3, 1, 0, 2] : List Nat)[3])) = [1, 0] ∧
      (([3, 1, 0, 2] : List Nat).eraseIdx 3).filter
        (fun x => !(decide (x < ([3, 1, 0, 2] : List Nat)[3]))) = [3]

theorem four_reordered_exercise_mean :
    exerciseMean natLt [3, 1, 0, 2] = (109 : ℝ) / 3

theorem distinct_tags_repeated_keys :
    ([(1, false), (1, true), (2, false)] : List (Nat × Bool)).Nodup ∧
      ¬ (([(1, false), (1, true), (2, false)] : List (Nat × Bool)).map Prod.fst).Nodup

theorem repeated_key_rank_is_not_left_size :
    (occurrenceRank (Prod.fst : Nat × Bool → Nat)
      [(1, false), (1, true), (2, false)] (1 : Fin 3)).val = 1 ∧
    ((([(1, false), (1, true), (2, false)] : List (Nat × Bool)).eraseIdx 1).filter
      (fun x => decide (x.1 < 1))).length = 0

theorem equal_keys_keep_quadratic_mean :
    exerciseMean natLt [2, 2, 2] = 25 ∧
      exerciseMean natLt [2, 2, 2] ≠ sizeMean 3

theorem tagged_inputs_equal_mean {τ : Type u} {κ : Type v} {υ : Type w} {ν : Type z}
    [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder ν] (xs : List (κ × τ)) (ys : List (ν × υ))
    (hx : (xs.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (hy : (ys.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b : κ × τ => decide (a.1 < b.1)) xs =
      exerciseMean (fun a b : ν × υ => decide (a.1 < b.1)) ys
